description: Exact-arithmetic reference values (no NumPy or metric libraries).

metric_definitions.count: number of pairs with finite obs and sim
metric_definitions.relative_bias: sum(sim - obs) / sum(obs); null if sum(obs) == 0
metric_definitions.mean_absolute_relative_error: sum(|sim - obs|) / sum(obs); null if sum(obs) == 0
metric_definitions.relative_median: median(sim) / median(obs) of quantile-sketch values (each value snapped to its 0.1% bucket's representative); null if median(obs) == 0
metric_definitions.relative_standard_deviation: std(sim) / std(obs), population std; null if obs is constant
metric_definitions.mean_absolute_percentage_error: 100 * mean(|sim - obs| / |obs|) over pairs with obs != 0; null if none
metric_definitions.symmetric_mean_absolute_percentage_error: 100 * mean(2|sim - obs| / (|obs| + |sim|)); pairs with both 0 count as 0
metric_definitions.normalized_mean_absolute_error: mean(|sim - obs|) / mean(obs); null if mean(obs) == 0
metric_definitions.pearson_correlation: Pearson correlation; null if obs or sim is constant (spread within 16 eps counts as constant)
metric_definitions.spearman_correlation: Spearman correlation of average ranks; null if obs or sim is constant
metric_definitions.coefficient_of_variation_ratio: (std(sim)/mean(sim)) / (std(obs)/mean(obs)); null if obs is constant or a mean is 0
metric_definitions.root_mean_standard_deviation_ratio: rmse / std(obs); null if obs is constant
metric_definitions.nash_sutcliffe_efficiency: 1 - sum((sim - obs)^2) / sum((obs - mean(obs))^2); null if obs is constant (spread within 16 eps counts as constant)
metric_definitions.kling_gupta_efficiency: KGE 2009 (Gupta et al.): 1 - sqrt((r-1)^2 + (alpha-1)^2 + (beta-1)^2), alpha = std(sim)/std(obs) (population std), beta = mean(sim)/mean(obs); null if obs or sim is constant or mean(obs) == 0
metric_definitions.kling_gupta_efficiency_mod1: KGE' (Kling et al. 2012): as kge with alpha = cv(sim)/cv(obs), cv = std/mean; null if obs or sim is constant or a mean is 0
metric_definitions.kling_gupta_efficiency_mod2: KGE'' (Tang et al. 2021): 1 - sqrt((r-1)^2 + (alpha-1)^2 + beta^2), alpha = std(sim)/std(obs), beta = (mean(sim) - mean(obs))/std(obs); null if obs or sim is constant
metric_definitions.mean_crps_ensemble: mean over cases of mean|x - y| - sum|x_i - x_j| / (2 m^2) (fair: / (2 m (m - 1))); one member: |x - y|
metric_definitions.mean_brier_score: mean over cases of (fraction of members >= t - [obs >= t])^2
metric_definitions.mean_pinball_loss: mean over rows of q (y - x) if y >= x else (1 - q)(x - y)
metric_definitions.interval_coverage: fraction of cases with lo <= y <= hi (levels default 0.05, 0.95)
metric_definitions.mean_interval_score: mean of (hi - lo) + (2/alpha) max(lo - y, 0) + (2/alpha) max(y - hi, 0)
metric_definitions.mean_absolute_scaled_error: mean over pairs with scale > 0 of |sim - obs| / scale (scale: a per-pair column)
metric_definitions.ensemble_spread: sqrt(mean over cases of the members' variance, m - 1 denominator)
metric_definitions.ensemble_mean_root_mean_square_error: sqrt(mean over cases of (mean of members - y)^2)
metric_definitions.spread_skill_ratio: sqrt(mean over cases of (m + 1) / m x variance) / ensemble_mean_rmse
metric_definitions.rank_frequency: fraction of cases whose rank (members < y + floor(members == y / 2)) is k
metric_definitions.rank_outlier_fraction: fraction of cases with rank 0 or m
metric_definitions.rank_histogram_reliability: sum over k = 0..m of |rank_frequency(k) - 1 / (m + 1)|; null for mixed ensemble sizes
metric_definitions.hits: pairs with obs >= t and sim >= t
metric_definitions.misses: pairs with obs >= t and sim < t
metric_definitions.false_alarms: pairs with obs < t and sim >= t
metric_definitions.correct_negatives: pairs with obs < t and sim < t
metric_definitions.flow_duration_curve_slope: (ln Q(0.33) - ln Q(0.66)) / 0.33, Q(e) = quantile 1 - e (type 2) of quantile-sketch values (0.1% buckets); null if <= 0
metric_definitions.max_value_time: earliest time of the maximum of one side
metric_definitions.max_value_time_delta: seconds from earliest time of max(obs) to earliest time of max(sim)
metric_definitions.annual_peak_flow_bias: sum of (annual max(sim) - annual max(obs)) / sum of annual max(obs); years start in year_start_month (default 1)
metric_definitions.center_of_timing: mean over years of sum(q_d d) / sum(q_d): q_d the day's mean of one side (UTC days), d the day of the year from 1 (years start in year_start_month, default 10); days with q_d <= 0 left out; a year with fewer than (1 - missing_day_threshold) x its length days present left out (default 0.1); null if no year is left
metric_definitions.standard_deviation_of_timing: mean over years of sqrt(sum(q_d (d - c)^2) / (sum(q_d) (n - 1) / n)), c the year's center of timing wrapped into 1..length, n its days with flow (needs n > 1); days and years as center_of_timing

cases.name: perfect
cases.note: sim == obs: NSE = KGE = r = 1, errors 0

cases.name: constant_obs
cases.note: obs has zero variance: NSE, r, KGE undefined

cases.name: constant_sim
cases.note: sim has zero variance: r and KGE undefined

cases.name: ties
cases.note: tied values: Spearman uses average ranks; even count: median of the middle two

cases.name: zeros
cases.note: zero obs: MAPE uses the non-zero pairs; a pair with both 0 is 0 error in sMAPE

probabilistic.description: Ensemble and quantile forecasts in long format (one row per member or quantile; rows of a case share obs). Exact values, checked against scoringrules.
